extracted.name: Strawberry Pretzel Salad
extracted.description: Strawberry pretzel salad is the perfect crowd-pleasing dessert featuring a crunchy pretzel crust with a creamy filling and sweet strawberry layer on top.
ingredient_lines: 1 (8 ounce) container frozen whipped topping, thawed
instruction_lines: Gather all ingredients and preheat the oven to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C).
Stir crushed pretzels, melted butter, and 3 tablespoons sugar together until well-combined; mix well and press mixture into the bottom of a 9x13-inch baking dish.
Bake in the preheated oven until set, about 8 to 10 minutes; set aside to cool.
Place cream cheese and 1 cup sugar in a large bowl. Beat with an electric mixer until smooth; fold in whipped topping. Spread mixture onto cooled crust.

Dissolve gelatin in boiling water. Stir in still-frozen strawberries and allow to set for a few minutes, until the mixture "looks like egg whites." Spoon and spread over cream cheese layer; refrigerate until set, at least 2 hours.
